name: Corpus Search
description: Installs a workspace-isolated Markdown corpus search CLI and skill. Teams opt in manually; code auto-updates; uninstall preserves generated stores. Each workspace gets local BM25 retrieval and optional OpenAI-backed hybrid search and reranking through secure-fetch. On first use, Runneth inspects only the current workspace's brain, recommends useful sources, and lets the person approve the exact index plan with one yes.
